The starting line 'IAO(or resistance..depends ifgoinvs EBO)' names two alternatives (Imperial Arrest Order or Resistance, depending on the matchup), so it is printed as written.

The list as posted has 1 Ommni Box & It's Worse; the strategy says 'Opps forgot a card make that 2 ommni box&its worse', so the row is 2 and the total is 60 (section counts 7 + 5 + 19 + 4 + 4 + 5 + 16).

Posted 'The Mauler' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine) and 'Mauls mauler' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Dildo' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber and 'Vaders probe' (in the weapons section; the strategy says Vader and Maul get 'their sticks') Vader's Lightsaber; 'Emperor wrinkly' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Booby fett/wGun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Bossk w/gun' dested Bossk With Mortar Gun; '4-LOMw/Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Snooovs' dested Snoova.

Posted 'Drug deal' (in the Effects section) dested the Cloud City Effect Dark Deal; 'I didn't really have a choice' dested the Cloud City Effect I Had No Choice; 'SaD' dested Search And Destroy; 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay).
Twi'lek Advisor is the Jabba's Palace interrupt; Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect (not a Defensive Shield in 2001).
No Coruscant-set cards are listed, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
